notes: Card explanations are educational game text; measurements, labels and source URLs resolve from immutable NASA fact/source IDs. Unlock only after the matching completed mission.

cards.title: Sunlight powers the base
cards.body: Solar panels need sunlight. Watch generation change when your base enters night.

cards.title: A day on Mars
cards.body: A Martian solar day is called a sol. Plan stored energy for the dark hours.

cards.title: Keep the habitat warm
cards.body: This is a planet-wide mean, not a forecast for your base. Turning off a heater has a cost.

cards.title: Dust blocks sunlight
cards.body: NASA reports this direct-sunlight share at tau 3. The game uses simplified weather and power rules.

cards.title: A rover in a great storm
cards.body: This is a measurement from Opportunity during the 2018 storm. Higher tau means dustier skies.

cards.title: Mars air is different
cards.body: The outside air is mostly carbon dioxide. Our habitat needs its own life-support plan.

cards.title: Plan oxygen for the crew
cards.body: This reference estimate includes exercise and a reference astronaut. Game reserves are simplified.

cards.title: Radiation at Gale
cards.body: Curiosity measured this average at Gale from August 2012 to June 2013. It is not a safe-dose limit.

cards.title: The trip also needs protection
cards.body: Curiosity measured this average galactic-cosmic-ray dose during its journey. Game shelter rules are simplified.

cards.title: Where explorers look for ice
cards.body: Remote-sensing evidence helps choose where to explore. A promising site still needs careful planning.

cards.title: Ice beneath the surface
cards.body: In parts of Arcadia, NASA reports ice less than this depth below the surface. Finding ice is different from extracting water.

cards.title: Pack food for the mission
cards.body: This is an ISS planning value for packaged food, not a Mars farming yield.

cards.title: Water for each crewmember
cards.body: This is minimum drinking water. Hygiene needs depend on the mission.

cards.title: A different world to work on
cards.body: Mars has its own surface gravity. Construction timings and walking distances in BASE 67 are game values.

cards.title: A home with its own air
cards.body: This is the mean surface pressure at the reference radius. Our crew relies on a protected habitat.
